exported_interface.input: context mapping (n, k, intercept, axes, subject_raw, predict_original, pvalues, f_pvalue, amplitude_pct, documentary, statistical, intervals)
exported_interface.output: NormativeAssessment mapping (edition, rule_sources, verification_status, fundamentacao, precisao, documentary, issues)

consumers.request: Pass predict_original(subject_raw) using the same fitted pipeline in original units; pass effective n, k and intercept (do not infer k as shape[1]-1). Without the callback, item 4 stays pending/0 when any axis is outside [min, max]. In-sample still scores Grau III.
consumers.acceptance_case: C03-A01: area sample [50,100], subject 150, y=10000*area → boundary Δ=50%, item 4 not approved. After C04 wires the callback, the same numbers must appear on CandidateAssessment.normative.

consumers.request: Use assess_normative / CandidateAssessment.normative in ranking. Do not treat item-4 measure-only as a pass. Do not treat grau as issuance.
consumers.acceptance_case: A candidate whose only item-4 support is faixa 0.5min–2max must not outrank one that satisfies (a)+(b) or is in-sample.

consumers.request: Additive snapshot fields only. Map fundamentacao, precisao.status (not_computed|classified|unclassified|error), documentary evidence_status, statistical warnings, and issues. Do not recalculate classifications. Do not set issuance to ready_for_professional_review from grau. C03 does not edit modules/results.py.
consumers.acceptance_case: precisao.status remains one of the four enum values; documentary declared without provenance is not verified; grau_nao_e_emissao issue is preserved.

consumers.request: Render pending/not_applicable/error distinctly from classified grau. Keep IC mean, prediction interval, campo de arbítrio and admissíveis labeled separately.
consumers.acceptance_case: A01 item 4 grade 0 / pending value-check is visible; precisão unclassified is not printed as Grau 0.
